description: A small toy kitchen set is in front, with a gray refrigerator next to an oven, and a loaf of bread and a small red strawberry-like piece lying on the countertop. The right hand reaches up to the refrigerator handle and pulls the door open toward the viewer while the left hand stays low; then the right hand picks up the bread and places it onto the middle shelf, picks up the red piece and sets it beside the bread, and finally swings the refrigerator door closed with the right hand.
